name: Kashiwagi Serena
source:
Serena is a composed senior and an elite magical girl who has slaughtered thousands of monsters and combatants in the past. She is kind enough to try to defend the townspeople and shows no mercy to those trying to disrupt the peace. She is feeling pressure from excessive hopes by her parents, who are leaders of the organization for justice. By the way, her favorite dish is gyouza.

"Evil does not reach justice; science too, does not reach magic."
